---
title: "Require head branch"
description: "Only lets pull requests into a branch come from one specific branch."
---

`require-head-branch.yml` fails a pull request whose source branch isn't
`allowed-head`. Its job name is what you make a **required status check**
on `main`, so that only `dev` can ever be merged there — see
[Branch protection](branch-protection.qmd).
